plan.title: Single-stage reverse auction rejects zero quantity

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to Auction, representing the reverse auction flow.
Provide the required event title before attempting publication.
Select the first available auction template so the pricing sheet is configured.
Add the specified product and enter the invalid requested quantity of zero.

args.contains: Quantity must be greater than zero

steps.note: Immediately verify that the quantity cell is rejected with the required validation message.
Add one available QA vendor to satisfy the participant prerequisite for the publication attempt.
Commit the 30-minute schedule required before publication.
Attempt publication and assert that the invalid quantity prevents the event from being published.
